summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated opaque bundle
details: This package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin for neverthrow but its package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that runs on every `npm install`. The setup.mjs loader is obfuscated (hex-prefixed identifier aliases `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x24db8d` for fs/https/os/path/zlib, string-array indirection). It downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array rotator and a large numeric/string constant pool. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node evades scanners and inspection that only cover Node code paths, and the payload's behavior is not auditable from source. An ESLint plugin has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime and execute a large opaque bundle at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
